attendee.preheader: Key takeaways on scaling AI in HR from our live session.
attendee.body_md:
Hi {{firstname}},

Thank you for joining us live for "From Hype to High-Impact: How to Start and Scale AI in HR." It was a valuable discussion on what it really takes to start, scale, and govern AI in HR across the employee lifecycle.

**{{takeaway_headline}}** {{takeaway_body}}

Here are a few key takeaways from the session:

*   Hypergrowth necessitates a scalable HRIS for global operations. [01:17]
*   AI's core HR metric: doing more with less. [04:47]
*   AI in HR requires cautious experimentation and controlled environments. [12:05]

As Q Hamirani shared, "Yeah, so I think like a lot of us even I think in the in the poll kind of reflected. I think we are all in various journeys of AI within different processes in the HR space as well. So there isn't one single metric, well if there is one single metric I would say, it's can we do more with less, right?" [04:47]

Watch the full recording here: [Session Recording]({{recording_link}})

Ready to explore how AI can transform your HR operations? [Learn More]({{cta_link}})

The Darwinbox Team

recipients.subject: AI in HR: From Hype to High-Impact
recipients.body_html:
Hi Ahmad,

Thank you for joining us live for "From Hype to High-Impact: How to Start and Scale AI in HR." It was a valuable discussion on what it really takes to start, scale, and govern AI in HR across the employee lifecycle.

Embrace AI as a new teammate for capacity and growth. AI is a powerful new teammate that can unlock capacity, allowing individuals and teams to achieve more and focus on higher-value, strategic work. By experimenting with AI tools and upskilling, you can drive innovation and accelerate organizational growth. [28:16] Commercial organizations can benefit from AI by unlocking employee capacity, enhancing data-driven decision-making, and ensuring ethical AI implementation to foster agility and innovation across the employee lifecycle. [28:16]

Here are a few key takeaways from the session:

recipients.body_html:
Hi Q,

Thank you for your valuable contribution to our recent event, "From Hype to High-Impact: How to Start and Scale AI in HR". Your insights were instrumental in exploring what it really takes to start, scale, and govern AI in HR.

Here's a snapshot of how the session performed:

  • Registrants: 140
  • Attendees: 77
  • Attendance Rate: 55%%
  • Average Watch Time: 30.2 minutes
"Yeah, so one of the, I guess the underlying reason on why we were exploring an HRIS to begin with as I zoom out into our journey, was we have experienced tremendous hyper growth in the last year or two." -- [00:17]
"Um, so we embarked on a journey to pick the next HRIS for us. Um, for our journey, um, through what I call is kind of the inflection point on us growing up." -- [01:17]
"Yeah, so I think like a lot of us even I think in the in the poll kind of reflected. I think we are all in various journeys of AI within different processes in the HR space as well. So there isn't one single metric, well if there is one single metric I would say, it's can we do more with less, right?" -- [04:47]

We've made the recording available here: https://explore.darwinbox.com/lp/resources/events/webinar-how-to-start-and-scale-ai-in-hr?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=from-hype-to-high-impact-2026-08-13&utm_content=speaker-a

We encourage you to share the recording with your network. You can find a direct link to the recording here: https://explore.darwinbox.com/lp/resources/events/webinar-how-to-start-and-scale-ai-in-hr?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=from-hype-to-high-impact-2026-08-13&utm_content=speaker-a
